findings.explanation: The ADR sets a fixed hard cap of 3 retries but does not address whether this limit can be configured per merchant; the requirement demands per-merchant configurability, which could either mean a configurable value up to 3 (compatible) or a per-merchant value potentially exceeding 3 (conflicting), so the relationship is ambiguous without further scope clarification.

findings.explanation: ADR-PAY-001 governs retries for "failed transactions" with exponential backoff, while the requirement concerns "webhook delivery retries" with a fixed 1-second backoff; it's unclear whether webhook deliveries fall under the same "failed transactions" scope as the ADR, so a direct conflict cannot be confirmed without clarifying if these are the same retry mechanism.
findings.headline: Confirm the scope of ADR-PAY-001
